source_evidence: Player exact: 'I would never commit either of your houses to anything without your consent. I only ask to represent our shared interest and alliance. When I commit to something it will either be in my own house’s name or get explicit permission from you. The benefit is that when any of us speak, it will be known that there are three house’s power potentially behind those words, even if its not actually true (if one or two of us disagrees).' Elara understands the difference between credible potential collective backing and binding authorization, independently supports the consent-based political alliance in principle and asks that no member falsely expressly claim another house has consented; disagreements need not be advertised, but explicit joint commitments require agreement of affected houses. Elara proposes a concise shared memorandum for Lord Severin's review, not already drafted or sent. Her private engagement and earlier legal status unchanged. No persuasion check, no oath or actual political/military commitments; no other V speech or choice invented. D310~19:10 private drawing room Rethwyn rural manor. V explicitly clarifies that no house will be committed without its own consent; Vaishnavi coordinates and represents shared interests, each house may speak in its own name, alliance reputation conveys potential collective backing even if members disagree. Elara independently welcomes and accepts those principles in principle, distinguishing the deterrent of potential support from false express claims of authorization; proposes putting these terms in a common memorandum for Severin's review and asks if V wants this prepared. No actual document drafted, dispatched or signed, no formal pact, fealty, transfer, joint expenditure or military commitment, no Nightglass letter receipt newly confirmed. Marriage preliminary clerk advice remains; joint Caereth recognition visit intended but no official approval. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 all pools full; Fenar59/59 HD5/6 Rage3/4 Shift2/3 inactive MP6/6; Cirren51/51 HD4/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 full; Mara and four horses healthy. LongRest2/6 purse391gp9sp6cp food12/feed16 PixieDust1 peryton specimens in coach; custody unchanged. No overnight, departure or costs. V dice delegated until stop.
